observations: Reference and rebuild carry the same content in the same order: Procedures/Surgical History header with close, Edit Event card with trash action, Procedure Code with the Status pill, Related to problem select, Facility Name, Comments, and the Cancel / Save & Add to Note / Save footer. No tab strip in either.

The rebuild is 32px taller than the 498px source (530): 72/71 shell regions and a 16px body inset above the card where the source has 8. Both contents sit inside the 600px slot with nothing false below them; the backdrop shows through under both.

The Status pill renders in the source colour through color/core/light at 90x32 with the library Regular 16 label, the same stand-in as item 1; the Dropdown chip GAP marker is placed beside the comparison.

Footer renders 'Save & Add To Note' from the stored sentence-case label; logged per npve.buttonLabels.
